# RoboDawn Vulkan compatibility subset

Unmodified files from [Hugo-AGI/RoboDawn](https://github.com/Hugo-AGI/RoboDawn/tree/9247f366cd31f278e10f2fbe5fe8469b5f1b5b94), commit `9247f366cd31f278e10f2fbe5fe8469b5f1b5b94`. The original MIT [LICENSE](LICENSE) is included. Only the two Vulkan compatibility/probe scripts are vendored; this is not a full RoboDawn checkout.

The wrapper extracts Khronos Profiles and libjsoncpp packages into this directory's `.cache/robodojo-vulkan`. Packages, extracted libraries and runtime caches are not tracked. See the [experiment runbook](../../docs/experiments/20260928_openwam/RUNBOOK.md).
